City Manager Abbate stated that on October 5, 2026, a significant water main break occurred at Garden Street and southbound US 1, requiring emergency repairs and road closures. Public Works crews replaced the damaged 6-inch water main, restoring water service by 9 p.m., and issued a boil water notice. The break caused extensive roadway damage, requiring emergency repairs by Masci General Contractors, Inc., under a $397,671 emergency purchase order. The intersection reopened on October 7, 2026 with final paving expected before the City Council meeting on October 13, 2026. The purchase order would be presented to Council for after-the-fact approval once final costs were confirmed.
